title: Abdominal ultrasound
what: The doctor looks at the organs in your belly with ultrasound: the liver, gallbladder, pancreas, and spleen. It is safe and uses no radiation.
why: For belly pain, a heavy feeling after eating, abnormal test results, or a routine checkup.
tell_doctor: If your gallbladder was removed or you have had belly surgery
If you recently had a gastroscopy or colonoscopy. Air may still be in the bowel
If you have diabetes. Fasting for a long time can be risky. Your doctor will advise you

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food for 6 to 8 hours. Best done in the morning on an empty stomach.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: Have a light dinner. Avoid fizzy drinks, beans, raw vegetables, dark rye bread, and milk. Less gas means a clearer picture.

prepare.title: Water and smoking
prepare.text: A little plain water is usually fine. Do not smoke or chew gum before the scan. It puts air in your belly.

prepare.title: Kidneys
prepare.text: If your kidneys and bladder are checked too, you may be asked to come with a full bladder. Check with your clinic.

bring: Past ultrasound reports and test results, if you have them
A tissue or towel to wipe off the gel
steps: You lie on your back with your belly bare
The doctor puts cool gel on your skin
A probe is moved over your whole belly
You are asked to breathe in deeply and hold your breath for a few seconds
Sometimes you are asked to turn onto your side
feel: The probe presses a little. It does not hurt
If an area is sore, pressing on it can be unpleasant. Tell the doctor
after: The gel is wiped off, and you can eat right away
You usually get the report right away

faq.q: Can I drink water before an abdominal ultrasound?
faq.a: Usually a little plain water is fine. Do not eat, and avoid sweet drinks, fizzy drinks, and coffee with milk.

faq.q: What does an abdominal ultrasound include?
faq.a: Usually the liver, gallbladder, pancreas, and spleen. The kidneys are often checked separately. Check with your clinic.

reminders.text: Abdominal ultrasound tomorrow. Have a light dinner with no fizzy drinks, beans, or raw vegetables.
From now on, do not eat until your ultrasound. A little plain water is fine.
